paragraphs.text:
The wolf drags you and your boot back to earth. Your leg twists 
awkwardly and you go down. The pack converges on you, snarling 
with bloodlust, jostling each other for a bigger share of your flesh.

Gunfire splits the air, as the students above try vainly to save 
you. But the wolves are lost in their frenzy. After a few seconds, 
your body already torn beyond repair, you get a glimpse up into 
the tree branches. A tearful Sylvia points her rifle directly at 
your head. “Sorry, Professor,” she says and squeezes the trigger.
The Nadelmann Expedition is over. THE END.
